//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the PROGRESS-RING component — the circular conic-gradient ring pa-progress-ring (keen `DataViz.progress_ring/1`, svelte `display/ProgressRing.svelte`). SCOPE: the ring block + its inner value/label. The fill is DATA-DRIVEN via an inline style `--value: N` (UNITLESS — the SCSS multiplies by 3.6deg for the conic sweep; there is NO % suffix, unlike pa-progress's fill which is `--value: N%`). Authored from dist/css/main.css + demo/views/data-visualization.mustache + _data-viz.scss.

propsVocabulary.value: 0-100 — sets the inline style `--value: N` (UNITLESS) on the ring AND is shown as `N%` inside pa-progress-ring__value
propsVocabulary.valueText: the text shown in pa-progress-ring__value. For a shared golden both wrappers render `N%`: keen auto-derives it from `value` (`<%= @value %>%`), svelte takes it via `valueText`. Scenarios set valueText to the matching `N%` string so the two wrappers agree; keen ignores this prop (not in its map) and auto-derives.
propsVocabulary.label: optional caption shown below the value in pa-progress-ring__label
propsVocabulary.variant: colour variant success|warning|danger|info — emits pa-progress-ring--{variant} (changes the conic fill colour). primary is the BASE (var(--pc-accent)) and emits NO modifier — there is NO pa-progress-ring--primary in core.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions:
Structural shape from demo/views/data-visualization.mustache:
N%LBL
. The `--value` inline style is UNITLESS and treated as a scenario-provided value so both wrappers receive the same input. primary is the DEFAULT variant and emits NO pa-progress-ring--primary class (guard). The __label span is omitted when no label is given. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-progress-ring(--|__)'): modifiers sm, lg, success, warning, danger, info — NO --primary (base is the accent). value/valueText/label/extraClass produce null (data-driven inline style / text content / passthrough).

value.note: data-driven — inline style `--value: N` (unitless) + shown as N% in __value; no class

valueText.note: the __value text; keen auto-derives from value (not in keen map), svelte takes it via valueText. Scenarios set it to the matching N% so the goldens agree.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

scenarios.name: no-label
scenarios.note: No label → the __label span is omitted.

scenarios.name: primary-default-no-class
scenarios.note: Guard: primary is the base fill; there is NO pa-progress-ring--primary in main.css. Must NOT emit a phantom modifier. (svelte emitted one before this slice — fixed in ProgressRing.svelte.)
